6. **That the invention so far as claimed in any claim of the complete specification is obvious or does not involve any inventive step, having regard to what was publicly known or publicly used in India or what was published in India or elsewhere before the priority date of the claim:** This focuses on the lack of novelty and inventiveness in the Ayurvedic patent.
